Class SpectralDataset

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.SpectralDataset
All Implemented Interfaces:
Encryptable, AutoCloseable
public class SpectralDataset extends Object implements Encryptable, AutoCloseable
Root reader/writer for TTI-O .tio files. Implements AutoCloseable for try-with-resources.

HDF5 layout: root group has @ttio_format_version and @ttio_features attributes. The /study/ group contains runs, identifications, quantifications, and provenance.

Compound metadata (§6 of format-spec). Writing emits the native HDF5 compound dataset and a JSON attribute mirror (transition-window behavior, §6.4). Reading prefers the JSON attribute because JHI5 1.10 cannot marshal VL-string fields out of a compound; when only the native compound is present, primitive fields are recovered via type projection and VL-string fields decode as empty strings. The mirror is emitted to keep Java-written files fully round-trippable by every implementation.

API status: Stable. Encryptable conformance is delivered in slice 41.5 when the encryption manager lands in Java.

Cross-language equivalents: Objective-C TTIOSpectralDataset, Python ttio.spectral_dataset.SpectralDataset.

    • references

      public Map<String, ReferenceImport> references()
      Returns embedded references discovered under /study/references/ on this dataset.

      Keys are reference URIs (the same string returned by GenomicRun.referenceUri()). Values are fully-materialized ReferenceImport instances ready for diff-based codecs and for inspection in user-facing tooling.

      Datasets written without embedded references (writer flag embedReference=false) return an empty map even if GenomicRun.referenceUri() is non-null on individual runs.

      Returns:
      unmodifiable map; never null
      Since:
      1.1.0

    • runs

      public Map<String,Run> runs()
      Phase 2: canonical mapping over every run in the file (MS + genomic), keyed by run name. Values conform to the Run interface so callers can iterate uniformly without knowing the underlying modality: 
        for (var entry : ds.runs().entrySet()) {
      Run run = entry.getValue();
      System.out.println(run.name() + ": " + run.count() + " measurements");
  }

      Use runsOfModality(Class) to narrow by class, or runsForSample(String) to filter by provenance sample URI. Phase 2 promotes this to the canonical access pattern; the legacy msRuns() / genomicRuns() maps continue to work, but new code should prefer runs().

      NMR runs are reported alongside MS runs because the Java implementation does not split them on disk — AcquisitionRun carries both modalities, and msRuns already covers both.

    • runsForSample

      public Map<String,Run> runsForSample(String sampleUri)
      Phase 1 (post-M91): every run associated with sampleUri. A run is considered associated when its provenanceChain carries sampleUri in any record's ProvenanceRecord.inputRefs. Walks all modalities (MS, NMR, genomic) uniformly via the Run interface — closes the M91 cross-modality query gap that previously had to fork on access pattern.

      Returns a map keyed by run name; empty when no run matches. Iteration order is the unified order of runs().

    • runsOfModality

      public Map<String,Run> runsOfModality(Class<? extends Run> runType)
      Phase 1 (post-M91): every run whose value is an instance of runType. Pass AcquisitionRun.class to get the union of MS + NMR runs (any spectrum-class subtype); pass GenomicRun.class to get genomic only. The return is a thin filter over runs().

    • open

      public static SpectralDataset open(String pathOrUrl)
      Open an existing .tio file for reading. (Java): a URL scheme (memory://, sqlite://, zarr://) dispatches to the matching StorageProvider and reads the whole dataset through the protocol (StorageGroup-based); bare paths (and file:// URLs) stay on the HDF5 fast path for byte parity with pre-M64.5 files and the cross-language smoke suite.

    • create

      public static SpectralDataset create(String path, String title, String isaInvestigationId, List<AcquisitionRun> runs, List<Identification> identifications, List<Quantification> quantifications, List<ProvenanceRecord> provenanceRecords, ProgressSink progress)
      Stage D overload of create(String, String, String, List, List, List, List) that fires progress.onProgress(sectionIdx, sectionCount) once per §5.4-ordered section as it is materialised. UI can drive a determinate progress bar showing "writing identifications..." with section-count progress.

      The total sectionCount reflects only sections that will actually be written (empty collections are skipped, so a spectral-only .tio with no identifications / no provenance fires fewer reports than one with the full set).

      The outer sink does not see byte counts (HDF5 does not expose those per-section cleanly); for per-record progress within a section, consumers should wire a sink directly into the relevant writer (e.g.

      invalid reference 
      MzMLWriter#write(AcquisitionRun, String, boolean, ProgressSink)
      ) — Stage D's writer side has those.

      Since:
      1.5.0

    • create

      public static SpectralDataset create(String path, String title, String isaInvestigationId, List<AcquisitionRun> runs, List<Identification> identifications, List<Quantification> quantifications, List<ProvenanceRecord> provenanceRecords, List<Subject> subjects, List<Sample> samples)
      Stage 6 (transport-spec v0.11, Deferral 2): create a .tio file with first-class Subject + Sample lists. Subjects are persisted as /study/subjects/<external_id>/ per-row groups; Samples as /study/samples/<sample_id>/.

      Validation per spec §4.4:

      • Duplicate Subject.externalId or Sample.sampleId raises IllegalArgumentException.
      • Sample.subjectExternalId that does not match any Subject in the same dataset logs a WARNING but does not fail (anonymous / cross-dataset samples are valid).

      AcquisitionRun.sampleName remains the canonical run → sample link string. Adding Sample rows does not change that contract.

      Since:
      1.4.0

    • create

      public static SpectralDataset create(String pathOrUrl, String title, String isaInvestigationId, Map<String,Object> runs, List<Identification> identifications, List<Quantification> quantifications, List<ProvenanceRecord> provenanceRecords, FeatureFlags featureFlags)
      Phase 2 (post-M91): mixed-Map create. The runs map may carry both AcquisitionRun (MS / NMR) and WrittenGenomicRun (genomic) values; this overload dispatches by instanceof on each value and forwards to the typed-list create API. Mirrors the Python SpectralDataset.write_minimal mixed-dict path.

      Run-name collision between an MS entry and a genomic entry raises IllegalArgumentException. Names are preserved on disk as-is — the genomic entries no longer get an automatic genomic_NNNN prefix when supplied via this overload, so callers control the storage name.

      values may be empty. Acquired ordering is preserved (use LinkedHashMap). Other parameters mirror the typed-list overload.

    • create

      public static Path create(String pathOrUrl, String title, String isaInvestigationId, List<AcquisitionRun> runs, List<WrittenGenomicRun> genomicRuns, List<Identification> identifications, List<Quantification> quantifications, List<ProvenanceRecord> provenanceRecords, List<Subject> subjects, List<Sample> samples, MSImage image, RamanImage ramanImage, IRImage irImage, ProgressSink progress)
      JT2: one-shot, image-aware create used by the importer/exporter registry. This is the single overload that carries the full normalized draft an importer produces: MS runs + genomicRuns + identifications / quantifications / provenance + subjects / samples + the three optional embedded images (MS / Raman / IR) + a ProgressSink. It forwards straight to createMixed(String, String, String, List, List, Collection, List, List, List, FeatureFlags) (the widest backend, with image embedding wired by JT1) using the legacy genomic_NNNN auto-naming scheme — matching the other typed-list create overloads. The created dataset is closed (flushed to disk) before returning so the caller may immediately open(String) it.

      invalid reference 
      ImportedDataset#write
      is the sole call site. Cross-language equivalent: the Python importer draft's write(...).

      Returns:
      the Path of the written .tio.
      Since:
      1.7.0

    • decryptWithKey

      public void decryptWithKey(byte[] key) throws Exception
      Decrypt every MS run's intensity channel into an in-memory overlay. Read-only: the on-disk file is NOT modified, the root @encrypted attribute is left in place, and isEncrypted() continues to return true on this instance and on any reopen.

      This is the asymmetric counterpart to encryptWithKey(byte[], global.thalion.ttio.Enums.EncryptionLevel) (which IS persistent + flag-flipping) by design: in-memory rehydration lets a process read encrypted data without rewriting the file. To fully reverse encryption on disk and clear the @encrypted attribute, use the static decryptInPlace(String, byte[]) — close any open instance first.

      Cross-language equivalents: Python SpectralDataset.decrypt_with_key (same in-memory-only semantics; returns dict[str, bytes]), Objective-C -[TTIOSpectralDataset decryptWithKey:error:] (same).

      Specified by:
      decryptWithKey in interface Encryptable
      Parameters:
      key - raw key material matching the key used to encrypt
      Throws:
      Exception - if decryption fails (wrong key, data corrupt, etc.)

    • decryptInPlace

      public static void decryptInPlace(String path, byte[] key)
      v1.1.1: persist-to-disk decrypt. Strips AES-256-GCM encryption from the .tio file at path: for every MS run with an encrypted intensity channel, writes plaintext back as intensity_values and removes the encrypted siblings. Finally clears the root @encrypted attribute so isEncrypted() returns false when the file is reopened.

      Symmetric with encryptWithKey(byte[], global.thalion.ttio.Enums.EncryptionLevel) (which leaves the root attribute set). After this call the file is byte-compatible with the pre-encryption layout.

      The file must not be held open by another writer.

      Cross-language equivalents: Python SpectralDataset.decrypt_in_place, Objective-C +[TTIOSpectralDataset decryptInPlaceAtPath:withKey:error:].
